description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView widget used for displaying log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log entries with various priorities, handles exceptions, and supports chaining of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages within an Android activity.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data with priority, tag, message, and optional exception, then appends it to the log view and forwards it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to the StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the given string as a new line in the LogView.
